title.en: a slow walk through chapultepec on the holiday.
title.de: ein langsamer spaziergang durch chapultepec am feiertag.
title.tr: tatil gününde chapultepec'te yavaş bir yürüyüş.

line.en: monday 16 is a public holiday in most sources, and some shops may be shut. the park is open to walk; no forecast was found, so take a layer for the morning.
line.de: montag 16. ist laut den meisten quellen ein feiertag, geschäfte können geschlossen sein. der park ist zum gehen offen; keine wettervorhersage gefunden, also für den morgen eine jacke mitnehmen.
line.tr: 16 pazartesi çoğu kaynağa göre resmi tatil, bazı dükkânlar kapalı olabilir. park yürüyüşe açık; hava tahmini bulunamadı, sabah için bir katman alın.

sparks.why: Monday 16 nov is Día de la Revolución, a federal holiday most sources list (they differ on whether it is a rest day); no forecast found, so this is a holiday spark, not a weather one.
